capture_method: spec-conformant document validated against the published A2UI v0.8 specification (a2ui.org/specification/v0.8-a2ui/). No runtime execution — A2UI is a protocol spec, not a runtime; the golden is a static v0.8-conformant adjacency-list document. Component property names follow the v0.8 standard catalog (representative subset: Column/Card/Button).

model_notes.structure: adjacency-list: flat component list, tree rebuilt via id references (Column.children.explicitList / Card.child)
model_notes.version_negotiation: via catalogId URI (standard_catalog_url) or A2A extension URI; no in-message version field in v0.8
